incidents.name: Cellframe LP migration calculation flaw
incidents.notes: The Cellframe LpMigration contract computes the new-token payout from the pool's current reserves at migration time instead of a fixed snapshot, so skewing the old CELL/WBNB pool with a flash loan first made the migration pay out far more.

sources.ref: onchain review: LpMigration 0xB4E47c13dB187D54839cd1E08422Af57E5348fc1 created 2022-11-14T12:24:22Z by 0x65def3ea531fd80354ec11c611ae4faa06068f27, unrelated to attack sender 0x2525c811ecf22fc5fcde03c67112d34e97da6079; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: the attack contract 0x1e2a251b29e84e1d6d762c78a9db5113f5ce7c48 netted 245.5228 WBNB; 245.5228 WBNB x $306.55 at incidentTimestamp 1685585275 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $75,265, matching the ~$76k reported.
